notes: Adds one optional Workspace- and Brand-scoped presenter profile; no presenter is created implicitly.
Presenter profile stores descriptive presentation preferences only. This slice does not accept biometric enrollment, raw face/voice cloning media or provider secrets.
DEC-012 establishes Kairo-owned Presenter state plus a replaceable server-side AvatarProvider capability boundary.
Presenter profile readiness and runtime eligibility are separate: a saved enabled profile is not selectable unless the provider capability is configured and avatar rendering is healthy.
Creation may reference only an eligible presenter through a nullable durable presenterId; None remains the default and existing creation behavior remains valid.
Avatar is a Brand sub-surface only and follows product/DESIGN.md before repository design skills.
No production Avatar provider adapter, worker/media-orchestrator change, provider credential/configuration change or generated test clip is authorized in this foundation slice.
Existing tenant isolation, human approval, exact Preview, publishing and channel credential boundaries remain unchanged.
VS-89 remains released and inactive in post-release observation. Issue #187 is explicitly deferred but open; authenticated Brand/Channels visual smoke must not be represented as validated.

approvals.rationale: The Product Owner said Go after the bounded next sequence was stated: preserve truthful VS-89 observation, then start the approved Avatar / Presenter work under DESIGN.md and existing provider boundaries.

The Product Owner approved Option A: Kairo-owned Brand-scoped Presenter state, private media, replaceable server-side AvatarProvider boundary, fail-closed eligibility and unchanged exact approval/publishing guarantees.
The Product Owner said Go after approving DEC-012 and after the sequence to defer #187 as an open observation, hand off VS-89 and activate VS-90 was restated.
